entities.name: KIN-10A (Q6K990)
observations: Reviewed Oryza sativa kinesin-like protein; query sequence matched at 100% identity and 100% query coverage, with target coverage 83.9%.
Contains a Pfam kinesin motor domain (PF00225) at query residues 95–391.
Reference annotations include ATP binding, microtubule binding, microtubule motor activity, and microtubule-based movement.

entities.name: Microtubule-based movement
observations: GO:0007018 is annotated for the exact-match rice KIN-10A reference; supports kinesin-associated movement but not a specific cargo by itself.

entities.name: Phragmoplast
observations: Arabidopsis KIN-10A homolog is reported in the phragmoplast and microtubule-associated during late anaphase; this is homolog-based localization evidence, not direct evidence for the query sample.
